Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You emphasise the continuing relationship and have noted spare capacity—it sounds like dependable business would be especially valuable to you. We want a straightforward, lasting arrangement with competitive pricing for the complete kit. What bundle discount could you offer in return for a longer contract commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.88 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
